method: The listed 75g dry egg noodles is an uncooked weight. Cut the 90g broccoli into small florets. Bring a saucepan of water to the boil, cook the broccoli for 3–4 minutes until just tender, then lift it onto a plate with a slotted spoon. Cook the noodles in the same boiling water for the time on their packet until tender, then drain well. Time this to finish shortly before the pan ingredients are ready.
Deseed and thinly slice the 90g mixed peppers. Drain and pat dry the 180g firm tofu, then cut into 2cm cubes.

Heat half the listed olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the firm tofu and cook for 8–10 minutes, turning carefully until lightly golden on several sides and hot through. Transfer to a clean plate; keep the pan for the vegetables. Never reuse the plate or utensils that held the raw food without washing them.

Add the remaining half of the listed olive oil to the same pan. Add 90g mixed peppers and cook for 4–6 minutes, stirring often, until softened with some bite. Keep the heat moderate so the small measured amount of oil does not smoke.
Add the drained noodles and broccoli to the pan. Toss gently for 1–2 minutes to combine without crushing the florets.

Turn the heat to low and fold in the 40g medium curry sauce. Stir for 1–2 minutes until hot, following any longer heating instruction on the sauce label. This measured sauce coats the food; do not boil it dry or add an unlisted jar of sauce.

Return the cooked firm tofu and any collected juices to the pan; fold gently to keep the cubes intact. Heat gently until the whole pan is steaming hot, stirring to distribute the heat. Divide the noodles, vegetables and firm tofu between serving bowls. Serve immediately.

notes: Golden 2cm firm tofu cubes, egg noodles, broccoli florets and softened thin red/yellow pepper strips have a light curry coating, with intact tofu folded through at the end.
